title: Everything you need,
subtitle: Built from the ground up as one connected platform — no patchwork of acquired tools, no hidden modules. Every feature below is included in one plan.

quadrants.title: CRM & Donor Management
items: Individual, household, and organization contact types
Custom badges — tag campers by year, donor type, affinity
Full giving history, pledges, and soft credits per contact
Activity tracking: emails, events, notes — all connected
Drag-and-drop reports with column-level filtering
Membership tiers and giving circle management

quadrants.title: Donor Outreach & Engagement
items: Drag-and-drop email builder — replaces Mailchimp / Emma
One-to-many and one-to-one text messaging
Letters, mail merge, and annual giving statements
Automated donor journeys — new donor, lapsed, anniversary
Every email and text tracked on the contact profile
Canva design integration for branded templates

quadrants.title: Online Giving
items: Unlimited giving pages — embedded on your website
Camper support pages with goal thermometers and tracking
Text-to-donate with unique keyword per campaign or camper
Recurring gifts, Apple Pay, Google Pay, DAF giving
Automatic receipts and thank-you emails on gift
Campaign, appeal, and fund tracking for accounting

quadrants.title: Project Management & Action
items: Action Board — daily prioritized task list per team member
Otto AI Smart Nudges — surfaces donor opportunities automatically
Ask Board — major gifts, grants, and sponsor pipelines
Project Boards — event planning, gala, grant workflows
Automations: external comms, internal tasks, data updates
Campaign year-over-year comparison reporting

footnote.title: One plan. All features. Nothing locked behind upgrades.
footnote.body: Every feature above is included at $500/month billed annually. Unlimited contacts. No tiers.
